revisionNote: The original bounded live samples below are historical. On 2026-10-28, the gated acceptance test repeated the isolated Yvette Clarke crawler/feed run, directly exercised live inaccessible-domain and no-policy-page cases, and captured all generated positions with their saved source text for manual semantic review. The successful crawls used a temporary local database that was dropped after the run. The edge cases used crawler-only fixtures and wrote no database rows; no production database was used.

crawlerGate: Current, unexpired verified and eligible ambiguous campaign sites with approved destinations can be selected by the campaign-position worker. Missing, proposed, rejected, expired, and unapproved sites remain excluded. A post-change bounded live ambiguous-site crawl saved two pages and published 16 source-validated positions to the isolated local feed; this does not establish nationwide site coverage.
